features.compact: 11px compact table names, smaller rows/header/PBP/live details. Extra-compact/comfortable density; strike zones default160px, adjustable130–230px.
features.background: Theme, solid, two-color gradient, scorebook grid or local raster image with dimming. Saved per device; local preferences export/restore.
features.pairedSplits: L/R selected, removed, migrated, ordered and saved as one unit in all shared stat pickers. Table columns remain adjacent and hero metrics share a paired cell.
features.customization: All tables save named layouts; Savant published tables customize columns; player headers include every numeric/null Savant source field with a source prefix. Persistent collapsible panels and game-display controls.
features.boxScores: No independent scope checkbox. Selected regular-season, L/R and playoff columns append after game stats; row order remains fixed.
features.team: Fielding integrated in Team Statistics leaderboards; compact depth-position cards and L/R real starting-nine views. Date controls support2015–2026; latest FanGraphs kept distinct.
features.intensity: Version7 monotonic calibrated curve; real2024WSG1=97, low/no-swing games near1; no rating for unplayed games.
features.wobaWAR: Custom wOBA-WAR with seasonal league wOBA,scale and runs/win; replacement runs default20per200IP, adjustable0–50. Exact baseball innings conversion; no park/defense/leverage adjustment.

limitations: Historical depth is ranked recent actual starts on the as-of roster, not a saved FanGraphs projection.
L/R dated lineups group by MLB listed starter handedness and preserve a real starting nine; no synthetic batting order is invented.
Usage stats in dated charts are real regular-season by-date-range samples; full-season Savant stats elsewhere retain full-season labels.
FanGraphs latest depth/platoon source may be unavailable; the app reports failures.
Bat tracking before2023 and MLB ABS before2026 remain unavailable.
